name: link-firehose-chain
description: The link firehose carried across a trunk of five pure transport nodes - six hops leaf to leaf, every packet switched five times each way. Same traffic as link-firehose-small-payload; the delta against the direct table IS the stacked per-hop transport tax: throughput lost to five switch decisions and rtt grown by five store-and-forwards, measured at the only place it matters - end to end.
conformance: sent == delivered + timeouts end to end across six hops; the trunk neither drops nor reorders on a quiet box
